item.title: 自动化 Hermitage 以了解 MySQL 和 MariaDB 中的事务有何不同

item.title: 通过默默无闻的安全性也不错
item.description:
📝 仅通过默默无闻的安全性是不好的（Kerckhoffs 原则）。 This is often dismissed as "worthless" because it is security through obscurity. I was spared thanks to that additional layer of security through obscurity.
🔤 Original: Security Through Obscurity Is Not Bad
🔗 Read more: https://mobeigi.com/blog/security/security-through-obscurity-is-not-bad/

item.title: 犹他州要求网站对使用 VPN 掩盖其位置的用户承担责任
item.description:
📝 迄今为止，唯一在阻止 VPN 流量方面取得进展并取得一定成功的国家是具有 ISP 级监控的独裁政权。 12 Comments 来自论坛的评论 政府不够聪明，无法通过这样愚蠢的立法来阻止这种情况。无论如何，会有很多种方法来规避这个问题。
🔤 Original: Utah to hold websites liable for users who mask their location with VPNs
🔗 Read more: https://www.tomshardware.com/software/vpn/utah-becomes-first-us-state-to-target-vpn-use-with-age-verification-law
